name: Hue Festival
summary: Festival Huế 2026 runs the whole year in four seasons. It opened at Ngọ Môn square on 1 January 2026 with the reconstructed Ban Sóc rite, and the International Arts Festival week is 13–18 June 2026. Through the year come court and folk rites, a mid-autumn lantern programme, and a winter music programme named for Trịnh Công Sơn, then a countdown on 31 December 2026. The conservation centre is the standing office. The ordinary citadel ticket is separate.
when: 1 January 2026 through 31 December 2026. Arts week 13–18 June 2026. Later years: Check on arrival.
